title: agentes-chat/agentes-chat
description: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals.
